lines.t:
CHAPTER 8
The Emerald World
A crater on a planet with a green sky. Peter lies at its centre, bruised and barely conscious.
Guardians, are you seeing this? A kid. A human kid, falling out of a hole in space.
Hang on, kid. We've got you.
Green light wraps around him. Bones knit. Bruises fade. Machines older than Nexa itself hum softly as they repair him cell by cell.
Curious. He carries something we have not seen in a very long time. A system of… becoming.
Where… am I?
Oa. Home of the Green Lantern Corps. You're welcome, by the way.
Thank you. I… I came to get stronger. Strong enough to protect the people I love.
Ha! I like him. Fine, kid. I'll train you. But Lantern training isn't about muscles — it's about will.
TRAINING: Go to the Oan Training Grounds. Train, then defeat a construct drone and the Construct of Fear.

scenes.title: The White Light

lines.t: The Central Battery of Oa. Rings from every Lantern corps orbit it like moons.
A ring chooses its bearer. Hold out your hand, Peter Parker.
A green ring drifts towards him — then stops. A yellow one. A blue. A violet. Each one hesitates.
They're… arguing?
All the rings flare at once. Their light braids together into a single, blinding white.
Willpower, hope, compassion, love… and life itself. A White Lantern.
Well. That's new.
What do I do with it?
Whatever you have the courage to become. But Oa cannot teach you everything. The multiverse is wide, and full of teachers.
So this is goodbye, huh? Don't you dare die out there, kid.
I'll come back and visit. I'll bring ramen.
What's ramen?
You'll love it.
White Lantern interface unlocked (SYSTEM → White Lantern). MULTIVERSE TRAVEL UNLOCKED.

scenes.hint: Complete 'Trials of Will' at the Oan Training Grounds.
